name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文中常说 come in this early 或 come so early，语气是日常问候，无需调整。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然。'背熟了'指把内容背得很熟，英文用 memorize 或 learn by heart 都地道；'别担心'用 Don't worry 自然。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That was such a sick move — I'm literally losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: "这波操作" is internet slang for "this move/play"; "太秀了" means "too impressive/flashy" (from 秀/秀儿); "我直接裂开" is slang meaning "I'm cracking up / I'm shattered / I can't even." Literal translation is nonsensical in English.
slang-01.free: That was such a sick move — I'm literally losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This of yours is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故，会误解。英语里对应的习语是 gild the lily（画蛇添足、多此一举），更地道自然。

short-01.reflect: 单字应答，语气随意，英文用 Yeah 最自然。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did do my homework—but my dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did write my homework, but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里"dog ate my homework"是众所周知的借口习语，语气应带点无辜又心虚的辩解感，用口语化表达更自然。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did do my homework—but my dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lyrics!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was sneaking a look at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，但"偷看词"在英文里更自然的说法是 sneak a peek at the lyrics/words；"偏头那一下"用 that head tilt 更口语化。整体语气是调侃揭穿，需保留。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lyrics!

corpus-03.output: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not dating/not in a relationship). "保持神秘感挺好的" is straightforward. The tone is casual and a bit playful, so the English should sound offhand and natural.
corpus-03.free: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语习惯。原文表达对某事来得太突然的惊讶，英语里常用"That was so sudden"或"So sudden?"来表达这种反应。

corpus-05.output: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Who even gets this?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络流行语，指事情离谱、让人摸不着头脑，不是字面的abstract；直译abstract在英文里不自然。“谁懂啊”是吐槽式反问，表示没人能理解，英文常用“who even gets this”或“who's with me”类表达。语气是调侃吐槽，需保留。
corpus-05.free: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Who even gets this?

corpus-06.output: Seems like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot videos from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: It seems to be true, I even scrolled to his concert's leaked videos.
corpus-06.reflect: "路透" here means fan-shot/leaked on-site footage, not Reuters; "刷到" is internet slang for coming across while scrolling. Need natural phrasing.
corpus-06.free: Seems like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot videos from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting, how come I didn't hear it?
corpus-07.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"班会"指班级会议，"我怎么没听着"是口语化的反问，表达没收到通知的疑惑，英文用"How come I didn't hear about it?"更自然。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-08.output: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe that makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple aura is so down-to-earth and approachable. You're not losing out this time—maybe you can even mooch a meal with that face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实的气质”指人看起来老实可靠、接地气；“亲民”指平易近人；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意为这次不亏、划算；“蹭顿饭”是口语，指白吃一顿、蹭饭。直译基本准确，但“mooch a meal with that face”稍显生硬，可调整为更自然的表达。
corpus-08.free: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe that makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，'要不要'表达的是征询意见，英文用'Should...'很贴切，'纪念品'译为'souvenir'正确，语气口语化，无需改动。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: "抽象" here is Chinese internet slang meaning absurd/ridiculous/out there, not literally abstract; the tone is teasing/mocking. "够抽象的" = "that's pretty out there/ridiculous."
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I get back to China.
corpus-11.direct: Alright, wait until I return to the country to deal with these poisonous chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for toxic motivational quotes/platitudes, not literal soup; "回国" means return to China. "行" here is agreement/concession. Need to render the slang naturally.
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I get back to China.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确传达了字面意思和调侃语气。'创作瓶颈'在英文中对应 'creative block' 更地道，'hit' 搭配自然。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — which one comes out on top?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — who is more superior?
corpus-14.reflect: 直译生硬，'谁更胜一筹'是成语，意为'谁更胜出/更好'，英文用'which comes out on top'或'which wins'更自然；'方案vs同事的PPT'是网络对比梗，指你的方案和同事的PPT比谁更强。
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — which one comes out on top?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that fake-deep expression—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Looking at that deliberately profound expression of his, you know there's a catfish, this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: 「有猫腻」是俗语，指有蹊跷、有隐情，不是字面的猫鱼；「故作高深」是装深沉；「一本正经的胡说八道」是网络流行语，指煞有介事地胡说，英文对应 deadpan nonsense / straight-faced bullshit。直译的 catfish 完全错误，需意译。
corpus-15.free: Just look at that fake-deep expression—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.
corpus-16.direct: Why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.
corpus-16.reflect: “我去”是感叹词，表惊讶/恍然大悟，不是“我去某地”；“不早说”是“怎么不早说”，带点埋怨的调侃；“朋友圈”是微信朋友圈，英文常说 Moments 或 WeChat Moments；“晒”是发/晒图，用 post 自然。整体语气是恍然后的调侃。
corpus-16.free: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.

corpus-17.output: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.
corpus-17.direct: No deal, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), not "no deal." "明码标价" means openly priced/tagged with a price—here it means love has become transactional. Need to keep the casual, cynical tone.
corpus-17.free: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.output: Not looking for a relationship. Go entertain yourself.
corpus-18.direct: No dating, go play by yourself.
corpus-18.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), and "自己玩去" is a dismissive "go amuse yourself / go away and play." Direct translation misses the romantic-rejection nuance and sounds odd.
corpus-18.free: Not looking for a relationship. Go entertain yourself.

corpus-19.output: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.direct: Look at the lottery ticket I bought, the winning numbers are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.reflect: 直译准确，但英文口语中更自然的说法是把'你看'处理成'Look'或直接省略，'中奖号码'译为'winning numbers'正确，'一模一样'用'exactly the same'自然。整体语气是惊讶/兴奋，保留。
corpus-19.free: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi north-south mung beans — I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south green beans, I'm holding it in at my workstation until I get internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米" is a viral pet meme (a cat/dog sound), "南北绿豆" is a nonsense meme phrase from a viral jingle; together they're playful internet gibberish. "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter so hard it hurts inside. Literal translation would confuse English viewers, so convey the meme-y nonsense and the stifled-laughter meaning naturally.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi north-south mung beans — I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

corpus-21.output: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.
corpus-21.direct: On the subway I ran into a big bro who kept talking to himself using anime lines the whole way.
corpus-21.reflect: “大哥”是口语中对陌生男子的称呼，不是字面“big brother”，英文用“guy”更自然；“全程”指整个乘车过程；“动漫台词”即 anime lines。整体语气是吐槽式叙述，保持口语化。
corpus-21.free: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: Last night I stayed up watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.direct: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确自然，'laughed until my stomach hurt' 是英语中表达笑到肚子疼的地道说法，'stayed up late' 对应熬夜，语气轻松口语化，无需调整。
corpus-22.free: Last night I stayed up watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: I was in such a hurry to leave that I mistook a rag for a towel and brought it to the office.
corpus-23.direct: In a hurry to go out, I directly took the rag to the company as a towel.
corpus-23.reflect: 直译准确但生硬。'着急出门'可更自然地表达为'was in such a hurry'，'直接把抹布当毛巾带公司去了'需体现'误把抹布当毛巾'的意味，用'mistook...for...'更地道。
corpus-23.free: I was in such a hurry to leave that I mistook a rag for a towel and brought it to the office.

corpus-24.output: Not dating. This drama's too big to even process.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating. The melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: "不处" is slang for "not dating / won't date"; "瓜" is internet slang for gossip/drama, and "啃不动" means it's too much to handle/digest. Literal "melon too big to bite" would confuse English viewers.
corpus-24.free: Not dating. This drama's too big to even process.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.reflect: 直译生硬。这句话是反问，表达"这本来就是应该的"，语气带理所当然或轻微反问。英文常用 Isn't that how it should be? 或 That's how it should be, isn't it?
corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.reflect: 直译准确自然，'保洁阿姨'译为 cleaning lady 符合英语习惯，'要和...结婚了'用 is going to marry 传达即将结婚的意思，语气平实，无需调整。
corpus-28.free: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?
corpus-29.direct: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike, which one is more suitable for heavy-weight fat-loss people?
corpus-29.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'大体重减脂人群'直译生硬，英文更常说'people with a high body weight who want to lose fat'或'heavier people trying to lose fat'；'动感单车'指spin bike/indoor cycling bike，'哪种更适合'用'which is better for'更自然。
corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh man, I can't even—I'll be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't got an embarrassing period-pad-buying story like that?
corpus-31.direct: Oh my, I can't take it anymore, this kind of experience I can laugh about for a year, who among everyone doesn't have a bit of a social-death story about buying sanitary pads!
corpus-31.reflect: 直译基本传达了意思，但"我不行了"是口语化的"笑到受不了"，"社死"是网络梗指尴尬到社会性死亡，需用地道英文表达，"大家谁还没点"是反问强调普遍性。
corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'll be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't got an embarrassing period-pad-buying story like that?

corpus-32.output: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, just leave me alone.
corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: “大妈们”指爱管闲事、爱唠叨的中年妇女群体，英文里没有完全对应的称呼，用 aunties 保留调侃意味；“放过我吧”是求饶，let me off the hook / leave me alone 更自然。
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, just leave me alone.

corpus-33.output: Watch Gen Z chat in internet slang
corpus-33.direct: Watch post-00s chat in Martian language
corpus-33.reflect: "火星文" is Chinese internet slang for the stylized, hard-to-read text (leet-like symbols, rare characters) that young people used online; "Martian language" is the literal but confusing rendering. English viewers would understand "in Martian" as alien language, so better to convey the idea of cryptic internet slang/text-speak.
corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in internet slang

corpus-34.output: I'm constantly getting interrupted by messages at work and can't stay focused. Any tips for improving efficiency?
corpus-34.direct: At work, I'm always interrupted by all kinds of messages, making it hard to focus on doing things. What methods are there to improve efficiency?
corpus-34.reflect: 直译准确，但英文表达略显生硬。'各种消息'可译为 'constant messages' 更自然，'难以专注做事'用 'hard to stay focused' 更地道，'有什么提高效率的方法'用 'any tips for improving efficiency' 更口语化。
corpus-34.free: I'm constantly getting interrupted by messages at work and can't stay focused. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-38.output: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie at her stall, and I suddenly wondered—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?
corpus-38.direct: Scrolling through videos, I saw the super-huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie's stall, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?
corpus-38.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'auntie's stall'略显生硬，'山东大妈'指摆摊的中年妇女，用'a Shandong auntie'自然；'煎饼果子'是天津叫法，山东煎饼是'jianbing'，但原文说的是'煎饼果子'，保留拼音加解释性处理即可；'全国最大'指中国范围内最大，用'in all of China'更清楚。整体语气是随口好奇，保持口语化。
corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie at her stall, and I suddenly wondered—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-39.output: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.
corpus-39.direct: Douban's high score of 9.4 also proves its quality.
corpus-39.reflect: 直译准确自然，'豆瓣9.4的高分'在英文语境中可保留 Douban 并说明是评分，'证明了它的品质'直译即可，语气平实陈述，无需改动。
corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-40.output: I can't handle this—happiness hit me way too suddenly!
corpus-40.direct: I can't take it anymore, happiness came too suddenly.
corpus-40.reflect: 直译准确，但"I can't take it anymore"在英文里常带负面/受不了的意味，这里表达的是被幸福冲击到招架不住，语气偏兴奋；"幸福来得太突然"是常见网络表达，英文可用更口语的感叹方式。
corpus-40.free: I can't handle this—happiness hit me way too suddenly!

corpus-41.output: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.
corpus-41.direct: Others: white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes. Me: Qiaolezi ice cream.
corpus-41.reflect: This is a meme contrasting something fierce (the tiger from Water Margin) with something soft/sweet (a Qiaolezi ice cream bar). '吊睛白额虎' is a set phrase for a fierce tiger; '巧乐兹' is a Chinese ice cream brand. The parallel '别人/我' structure is a common meme format meaning 'others vs. me'. Keep the contrast and the meme format.
corpus-41.free: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

corpus-42.output: Hahaha I can't even, people online this time are seriously too funny
corpus-42.direct: Hahaha I can't anymore, this batch of netizens is really too talented.
corpus-42.reflect: "我不行了" here means laughing too hard to handle it, not literally being unable to continue; "这届网友" is internet slang meaning "this generation of netizens" but colloquially just "people online"; "太有才了" means impressively clever/funny. Need a natural, casual English equivalent that conveys laughing uncontrollably and admiration for netizens' wit.
corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't even, people online this time are seriously too funny

corpus-44.output: I'm done. I've been working so much overtime I'm completely numb.
corpus-44.direct: I can't anymore, working overtime until I'm numb.
corpus-44.reflect: "我不行了" expresses exhaustion, "人都麻了" is slang meaning completely numb/drained from overwork. "I can't anymore" works but "I'm done" or "I can't take it" is more natural. "麻了" as slang means emotionally/physically drained, not literally numb.
corpus-44.free: I'm done. I've been working so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-45.output: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called... what is it, Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it clearly!
corpus-45.direct: I watch every one of your videos, your team is called that what Xiaochao Team right, I remember it all!
corpus-45.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"那个啥"是口语化的犹豫/回忆语气，英文用"what's it called"更自然；"我都记得的"表示清楚记得，用"I remember it all"可以，但更地道可说"I've got it memorized"或"I remember it clearly"。整体语气是热情粉丝的确认，需保留。
corpus-45.free: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called... what is it, Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it clearly!

corpus-47.output: Can you stop dragging me into playing games with you?
corpus-47.direct: Can you stop dragging me to play games?
corpus-47.reflect: 直译准确，但'dragging me to play games'稍显生硬；'拉着我'在此是'缠着我、非拉我一起'的意思，口语里更自然说'stop making me play games with you'或'stop dragging me into games'。语气是抱怨，需保留。
corpus-47.free: Can you stop dragging me into playing games with you?

corpus-48.output: I can't take it anymore—this is way too cute!
corpus-48.direct: I can't take it anymore, this is way too cute!
corpus-48.reflect: 直译准确传达了'我不行了'的夸张感叹和'太可爱了'的强调语气，'I can't take it anymore'在英语中常用于被可爱事物萌到受不了的场景，自然地道。
corpus-48.free: I can't take it anymore—this is way too cute!

corpus-49.output: I can't take it anymore—I know everything, I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.
corpus-49.direct: I can't anymore, I know it all, grinding until bald.
corpus-49.reflect: "肝到秃头" is internet slang meaning staying up late grinding so hard you go bald; "我不行了" here is an exhausted/overwhelmed reaction, not literal inability. Need natural English slang for overworking to the point of losing hair.
corpus-49.free: I can't take it anymore—I know everything, I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.
